title: achillea subcartilaginea
intro: Achillea subcartilaginea, commonly known as Himalayan yarrow, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan yarrow include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and essential oils, such as borneol and borneol acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
